issues.body: `_pr_reachable` only matches `uses:` when `./.github/workflows/...` immediately follows optional whitespace. Valid YAML such as `uses: './.github/workflows/release.yml'` or `uses: "./.github/workflows/release.yml"` is therefore absent from `graph`. If a PR-triggered workflow adds such a quoted call (directly or through an intermediate), `test_no_release_only_workflow_is_reachable_from_a_pr_trigger` remains green while edits to the allowlisted callee can affect a PR check, contradicting the claimed fail-closed inertness proof.
issues.fix_hint: Accept matching single or double quotes around local workflow references (and require a matching/valid closing quote or otherwise parse the scalar conservatively), then extend the transitive regression fixture with at least one quoted `uses` edge and assert the release workflow remains reachable. Treat any ambiguous local workflow reference conservatively rather than silently dropping it.
issues.title: Reachability scan misses quoted reusable-workflow calls

verdict.summary: The direct-trigger audit and current repository fixture pass, but the transitive caller proof is not fail-closed for valid GitHub Actions syntax. A quoted local reusable-workflow `uses` value is accepted by Actions yet omitted from the constructed graph, so a future PR-triggered caller could reach an allowlisted release workflow without making this guard fail. Because round 2 had no findings and this is a new major soundness gap, progress is regressing.
